notes: TEST ONLY. The private seed below is public on purpose so a signer on another system can reproduce these assertions. Never register this key with a real TA install and never reuse it anywhere else.

This file is generated by TA's own code (crates/ta-daemon/src/attention/vectors.rs) and a TA test fails if the committed file differs from the regenerated output. Regenerate with: TA_REGENERATE_VECTORS=1 ./dev cargo test -p ta-daemon attention::vectors

Each active vector is self-contained. To check a verifier: register registered_key (with test_key.public_key_b64) under install_id, evaluate at 'now' (a unix time, not the wall clock), build the item from item_state, present 'assertion' with request.action and request.answer, and compare with 'expect'. If presented_twice is true, the first presentation must be accepted and 'expect' describes the second.
A refusal 'reason' is the `reason` field of the 403 body from POST /api/attention/{id}/act. Messages are human text and are not part of the contract; only the reason string is.

item_digest is sha256 over the canonical JSON of {id, kind, summary, provenance, actions}. Canonical JSON means object keys sorted by byte order, no whitespace, UTF-8, strings escaped as serde_json does (only quote, backslash and control characters are escaped; every other character, including non-ASCII, is written as raw UTF-8). 'canonical_json' on each item is the exact string that was hashed.

Unicode: TA does NOT normalize. It never converts a summary to NFC or NFD, so the NFC and NFD items have different digests. A signer must hash and sign exactly the bytes of the summary TA published in the feed and must not normalize it. The only text shaping TA does to a summary is: control characters become spaces, runs of whitespace (including Unicode whitespace such as U+00A0) collapse to one space, leading and trailing whitespace is removed, and the result is capped at 280 characters.

Length: a summary of 280 characters is kept as is. A longer one is not refused: TA truncates it to the first 277 characters, removes trailing whitespace, and appends '...' (so at most 280). Lengths count Unicode scalar values (characters), not bytes. The digest covers the truncated summary, because that is what the feed publishes. 'summary_input' on an item shows the pre-shaping text when it differs.

Answers: answer_sha256 is sha256 over the exact UTF-8 bytes of the relayed answer text. TA does not trim, normalize or re-encode the answer before hashing, so trailing whitespace and newlines count. An assertion whose hash was computed over trimmed text is refused with answer_changed when the relayed text is not trimmed.
provenance null (no agent-side requester) and provenance with an empty-string excerpt are different values and have different digests.

The signature is over the exact base64url header and claims segments as sent (header.claims). A signer may serialize the JSON with any key order; the verifier parses it. Signatures are Ed25519 and deterministic, so the compact assertions in this file are stable.

role_order, maintainer_roles and escalation_min_role are the registered key's settings and are published by GET /api/attention metadata (keys[]). escalation_min_role is recorded and published now; the escalated viewer reroute that enforces it is the pending vector below.
jti must be 8 to 128 characters. TA keeps used jtis for at least 300 seconds, so a replay inside an assertion's lifetime is always refused.

test_key.WARNING: TEST ONLY. This key pair is published so another system can sign these vectors. Never register it with a real install.

vectors.description: Approve an any_maintainer draft as an admin, with a role claim. The item has provenance and the signer is not its requester.
vectors.name: approve_with_provenance

vectors.description: Approve an item whose provenance is null: nothing to self-approve against, the digest is over provenance null.
vectors.name: approve_provenance_null

vectors.description: Deny as an owner (owner is a maintainer role and outranks admin).
vectors.name: deny_as_owner

vectors.description: Answer an agent question as the user it waits on. No role claim is needed for a user-addressed item; answer_sha256 covers the exact relayed text.
vectors.name: answer_basic

vectors.description: Answer an item waiting on role member with an owner claim: rank-at-least under the default role order (member < admin < owner).
vectors.name: answer_role_rank_at_least

vectors.description: Approve with the escalated claim set (an item escalated to the owner because nobody held the role). TA accepts it on an any_maintainer item and records escalated true.
vectors.name: approve_escalated_claim

vectors.description: Approve your own agent-originated item with self_approval_permitted true: accepted and recorded as self_approved.
vectors.name: approve_self_approval_permitted

vectors.description: A registered key with a non-default role order and maintainer role: claim 'lead' satisfies an item waiting on role 'editor' (viewer < editor < lead).
vectors.name: approve_custom_role_order

vectors.description: Unicode summary in NFC form. The digest is over the exact bytes of the canonical JSON, so this and the NFD vector have different digests; each is accepted for its own item.
vectors.name: approve_unicode_nfc

vectors.description: Unicode summary in NFD form (same visible text as the NFC vector, different bytes, different digest).
vectors.name: approve_unicode_nfd

vectors.description: A summary of exactly 280 characters is kept whole.
vectors.name: approve_summary_280

vectors.description: A 281 character summary is TRUNCATED by TA to 277 characters plus '...' (280 total); it is not refused. The digest covers the truncated summary the feed publishes.
vectors.name: approve_summary_281_truncated

vectors.description: Provenance present but the excerpt text is the empty string: a different digest from provenance null and from a missing excerpt.
vectors.name: approve_empty_excerpt

vectors.description: The answer has trailing whitespace and answer_sha256 was computed over the exact text including it. TA hashes the relayed answer untrimmed, so this is accepted.
vectors.name: answer_trailing_whitespace_exact_hash

vectors.description: exp is in the past at the fixed now (lifetime itself is fine).
vectors.name: refuse_expired

vectors.description: iat is more than 30 seconds in the future at the fixed now.
vectors.name: refuse_not_yet_valid

vectors.description: exp is 61 seconds after iat: longer than the 60 second maximum.
vectors.name: refuse_bad_lifetime

vectors.description: The same assertion presented twice: the first presentation is accepted, the second is refused as replayed (jti already used).
vectors.name: refuse_replayed_jti

vectors.description: aud names a different TA install.
vectors.name: refuse_wrong_audience

vectors.description: The item changed after the person saw it: the assertion signed the published digest, the item's current digest differs. Refused as item_changed and nothing is done.
vectors.name: refuse_item_changed

vectors.description: The person signed approve but the relayed request is deny.
vectors.name: refuse_wrong_action

vectors.description: The assertion's item_id is a different item than the one being acted on.
vectors.name: refuse_wrong_item

vectors.description: answer_sha256 does not match the relayed answer (a swapped answer).
vectors.name: refuse_answer_hash_mismatch

vectors.description: The hash was computed over the TRIMMED answer but the relayed text keeps its trailing whitespace. TA does not trim before hashing, so the signer must hash exactly what is relayed.
vectors.name: refuse_answer_hash_over_trimmed_text

vectors.description: The header kid is not registered. An unknown kid, a wrong algorithm and a bad signature are deliberately indistinguishable (one reason) so a probe learns nothing about which keys exist.
vectors.name: refuse_unknown_kid

vectors.description: The signer is the requester of an agent-originated item and the claim self_approval_permitted is absent.
vectors.name: refuse_self_approval_without_claim

vectors.description: A member role cannot act on an any_maintainer item (maintainer_roles are admin and owner), even though it is signed correctly.
vectors.name: refuse_member_on_any_maintainer

vectors.description: Custom role order viewer < editor < lead: a 'viewer' claim does not satisfy an item waiting on 'editor'.
vectors.name: refuse_custom_role_order_too_low

intended.assertion_claims: user_id differs from waiting_on.value, escalated true, role at or above the registered key's escalation_min_role
intended.audit: TA records escalated true and the original waiting_on.value
